facts.fact: The Bank of Ghana revoked Zeepay's Dedicated Electronic Money Issuer licence on 14 July 2026 under Section 13 of the Payment Systems and Services Act, 2019 (Act 987), showing the Act in force.

Zeepay Ghana, a fintech company, held a Dedicated Electronic Money Issuer licence from the Bank of Ghana under the Payment Systems and Services Act, 2019 (Act 987), which the Bank revoked on 14 July 2026 over inadequate cash backing of e-money.
